column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rule configuration (plan task 46, T14).

# a deliberate decision and which test holds that decision in place; anything not listed is reported, and
# scripts/check_zap_report.py fails the build on Medium or higher.

# a seeded reveal page, the peek and whoami endpoints, the bundle, /healthz and a 404. The whole surface

column3: Modern Web Application: ZAP noting the page is script-driven, which is the design (client-side AES-GCM, T1). Not a finding. The one script it sees is the first-party bundle, pinned by SRI and the CSP script-src hash and checked by BundleIntegrityTests and headers.spec.ts.
